summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code, since execution was off-limits. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text with clickable_ranges click spans (width moved to fifth position); Opacity merges blended color into existing style so metadata is kept; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity_style.py, and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (plus tests/widgets/__init__.py). The layout resolver needed no change because its edge protocol already had size, min_size, and fraction defaults. Not verified by execution: the rich 11.2 behaviors the code relies on (Text.stylize, Style meta, render_lines pad flag). Judgment calls: bar position maps full-list indices to displayed tab spans, so duplicate names interpolate by full index during animation; letter search only applies to single-character keys; empty labels resolve as flexible edges. Mistake to disclose: I ran a find across the filesystem that touched other experiment directories, stopped it immediately, and read none of its output. Nothing was committed.
